GAMM figures for one cell of the GPT-2 estimator¶

Increment of W+<cue> over W per decision (word), from the per-token export of gpt_mi.py --summary. Choose the cell in the first cell; figures go to analysis/figs_syntax/gpt/<cell>/. Every fit has a speaker random intercept and an AR(1) term within sentence (estimated from the residuals; it has been ~0.01 so far). Integer axes use one mean per position rather than a spline, which rings on a spike-then-flat profile.

Parameters¶

In [95]:
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(mgcv); library(data.table); library(ggplot2) })

ROOT  <- "/Volumes/Transcend/seamless_interaction"
CELL  <- "incr_local"          # incr_local | incr_wide | whole_wide | whole_local
BASE  <- "W"                   # the words-only condition the increments are taken against
CUES  <- c("P", "V", "D", "P+V+D")   # increments of W+<cue> over W (a cue is skipped if its W+<cue> has not run)
MAX_N <- 400000                # decisions used for fitting (random sample of whole sentences)
NTHR  <- 6
FIGDIR <- file.path(ROOT, "analysis", "figs_syntax", "gpt", CELL); dir.create(FIGDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
PY <- path.expand("~/miniconda3/envs/default_env/bin/python")

Load (run python syntax/gpt_mi.py --summary first, any time; it collects every finished job)¶

In [96]:
# per-token export of the cell: written by `python syntax/gpt_mi.py --summary` (run it any time; it collects every
# finished job).  Columns: sid, tok_idx, speaker, fold, n_tokens, rel_pos, opens, closes, clause_end, lm_entropy,
# dist_to_clause_end, ce_<cond>, ent_<cond> for every condition that has finished folds.
pq  <- file.path(ROOT, "derived/syntax/results/gpt", sprintf("tokens_%s.parquet", CELL))
if (!file.exists(pq)) stop(sprintf("%s not found: run  python syntax/gpt_mi.py --summary  first (it writes the per-token export)", pq))
csv <- sub("\\.parquet$", ".csv", pq)
if (!file.exists(csv) || file.mtime(csv) < file.mtime(pq)) system2(PY, c("-c", shQuote(sprintf(
  "import pandas as pd; pd.read_parquet('%s').to_csv('%s', index=False)", pq, csv))))
d <- fread(csv)
setnames(d, gsub("\\+", "_", names(d)))                       # ce_W+P -> ce_W_P
have <- sub("^ce_", "", grep("^ce_", names(d), value = TRUE))
cat("conditions with results:", paste(sort(have), collapse = ", "), "\n")
d[, base_entropy := get(paste0("ent_", BASE))]
d[, pos01 := tok_idx / pmax(n_tokens - 1, 1)]
d[, from_end := pmin(n_tokens - 1 - tok_idx, 10)]; d[, from_start := pmin(tok_idx, 10)]
# openness: constituents still open when word t is heard = opened up to and including t, minus those closed before t
setorder(d, sid, tok_idx)
d[, open_now := pmin(cumsum(opens) - shift(cumsum(closes), 1, fill = 0L), 8), by = sid]
set.seed(1)
if (nrow(d) > MAX_N) { sids <- unique(d$sid); keep <- sample(sids, round(length(sids) * MAX_N / nrow(d))); d <- d[sid %in% keep] }
d[, speaker := factor(speaker)]; d[, fold := factor(fold)]

# long table of increments: one row per decision x item; each item is (base condition, condition, label), the increment
# being ce_<base> - ce_<condition>.  Items whose conditions have no results are skipped.
build_L <- function(items) {
  cols <- c("sid", "speaker", "fold", "tok_idx", "pos01", "from_end", "from_start", "base_entropy", "dist_to_clause_end", "open_now")
  out <- list()
  for (it in items) {
    b <- paste0("ce_", gsub("\\+", "_", it[1])); c <- paste0("ce_", gsub("\\+", "_", it[2]))
    if (!all(c(b, c) %in% names(d))) { cat("skipping", it[3], "(no results yet)\n"); next }
    out[[it[3]]] <- d[, c(cols), with = FALSE][, `:=`(cue = it[3], dI = d[[b]] - d[[c]])]
  }
  L <- rbindlist(out); L[, cue := factor(cue, levels = sapply(items, `[`, 3)[sapply(items, `[`, 3) %in% names(out)])]
  q <- quantile(L$dI, c(.005, .995), na.rm = TRUE); L[, dI := pmin(pmax(dI, q[1]), q[2])]
  L[, dist_to_clause_end := pmin(dist_to_clause_end, 8)]
  setorder(L, cue, sid, tok_idx); L[, start := tok_idx == 0]      # AR(1) runs within sentence, per cue
  L
}
items <- lapply(CUES, function(c) c(BASE, paste0(BASE, "+", c), sprintf("%s+%s - %s", BASE, c, BASE)))   # e.g. "W+P - W"
L <- build_L(items); cues <- levels(L$cue)
lab <- function(c) sprintf("%s+%s - %s", BASE, c, BASE)      # label of a cue's increment over the base
cat(sprintf("%s: %d decisions, %d sentences, %d speakers; cues %s\n", CELL, nrow(d), uniqueN(d$sid), uniqueN(d$speaker), paste(cues, collapse = ", ")))

conditions with results: D, none, P_D, P_full, P_V, P_V_D, V_all, V_nopause, W, W_D, W_P, W_P_V_D, W_V

Helpers¶

In [97]:
ylab <- "information beyond the words so far (nats / decision)"
# display names for the plots only (internal condition names are unchanged): D -> A (acoustic distinctiveness)
CUE_LABEL <- c(D = "A")
relabel <- function(x) {
  if (!is.factor(x)) x <- factor(x, levels = unique(x))
  lv <- levels(x); nl <- lv
  for (k in names(CUE_LABEL)) nl <- gsub(paste0("(^|[^A-Za-z])", k, "([^A-Za-z]|$)"), paste0("\\1", CUE_LABEL[[k]], "\\2"), nl)
  factor(nl[as.integer(x)], levels = nl)
}
ttl  <- sprintf("GPT-2 estimator, %s", c(incr_local = "incremental scope, local cue window", incr_wide = "incremental scope, wide cue window",
                                         whole_wide = "whole-sentence scope, wide cue window", whole_local = "whole-sentence scope, local cue window")[[CELL]])

# Fold is the unit of replication (each fold's increments come from a separately trained model), so every figure is
# fitted once per fold (speaker random intercept, AR(1) within sentence) and the population curve is the mean of the
# fold curves with a t-interval across folds.  (A single model with a fold random smooth is not identifiable here:
# the fold term absorbs the shared shape and the "population" curve becomes arbitrary.)
fold_fit <- function(axis, grid, formula_fn) {
  out <- list()
  for (f in levels(L$fold)) {
    # a cue whose W+<cue> has not finished on this fold has NA increments here: drop it from this fold's fit
    Lf <- L[fold == f & is.finite(get(axis)) & is.finite(dI)]; Lf[, cue := droplevels(cue)]
    if (nrow(Lf) == 0) next
    m0 <- bam(formula_fn(), data = Lf, method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = NTHR)
    rho <- acf(resid(m0), plot = FALSE, lag.max = 1)$acf[2]
    m <- bam(formula_fn(), data = Lf, method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = NTHR, rho = rho, AR.start = start)
    nd <- copy(grid)[cue %in% levels(Lf$cue)]; nd[, speaker := Lf$speaker[1]]
    nd[, fit := predict(m, nd, type = "link", exclude = "s(speaker)", discrete = FALSE)]
    nd[, `:=`(fold = f, rho = rho)]; out[[f]] <- nd
  }
  byfold <- rbindlist(out)
  keys <- setdiff(names(grid), "speaker")
  pop <- byfold[, .(fit = mean(fit), lo = mean(fit) - qt(.975, max(.N - 1, 1)) * sd(fit) / sqrt(.N),
                    hi = mean(fit) + qt(.975, max(.N - 1, 1)) * sd(fit) / sqrt(.N), n_folds = .N), by = keys]
  if (any(pop$n_folds < nlevels(L$fold))) cat("note: some cues are fitted on fewer folds:", paste(unique(pop[n_folds < nlevels(L$fold), paste(cue, n_folds)]), collapse = "; "), "\n")
  setattr(pop, "byfold", byfold); setattr(pop, "rho", mean(byfold$rho)); pop
}

# smooth along a continuous axis, one curve per cue
fit_smooth <- function(axis, k = 10) {
  xs <- seq(min(L[[axis]], na.rm = TRUE), quantile(L[[axis]], .99, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
  grid <- CJ(x = xs, cue = levels(L$cue)); setnames(grid, "x", axis)
  if (nlevels(L$cue) > 1) fold_fit(axis, grid, function() as.formula(sprintf("dI ~ cue + s(%s, by = cue, k = %d) + s(speaker, bs = 're')", axis, k)))
  else fold_fit(axis, grid, function() as.formula(sprintf("dI ~ s(%s, k = %d) + s(speaker, bs = 're')", axis, k)))   # a single curve
}

# one mean per integer position (no spline: a smooth through a spike at 0 rings)
fit_means <- function(axis) {
  L[, pos_f := factor(get(axis))]
  grid <- CJ(pos_f = levels(L$pos_f), cue = levels(L$cue))
  nd <- if (nlevels(L$cue) > 1) fold_fit(axis, grid, function() dI ~ cue * pos_f + s(speaker, bs = "re"))
        else fold_fit(axis, grid, function() dI ~ pos_f + s(speaker, bs = "re"))
  nd[, x := as.integer(as.character(pos_f))]
  bf <- copy(attr(nd, "byfold")); bf[, x := as.integer(as.character(pos_f))]; setattr(nd, "byfold", bf); nd
}

plot_smooth <- function(cv, axis, xlab, file) {
  bf <- copy(attr(cv, "byfold")); cv <- copy(cv); cv[, cue := relabel(cue)]; bf[, cue := relabel(cue)]
  p <- ggplot(cv, aes(x = .data[[axis]], y = fit, colour = cue, fill = cue)) +
    geom_line(data = bf, aes(group = interaction(cue, fold)), linewidth = .3, alpha = .35) +      # the five folds
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = .15, colour = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, title = ttl,
         subtitle = sprintf("fitted per fold (thin lines), speaker RE, AR(1) rho = %.2f; band: 95%% t-interval across folds", attr(cv, "rho"))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7.5, height = 4.8, dpi = 200); p
}
plot_means <- function(nd, xlab, file) {
  bf <- copy(attr(nd, "byfold")); nd <- copy(nd); nd[, cue := relabel(cue)]; bf[, cue := relabel(cue)]
  p <- ggplot(nd, aes(x, fit, colour = cue)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
    geom_point(data = bf, aes(group = fold), size = .7, alpha = .35, position = position_dodge(.45)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = .25, position = position_dodge(.45)) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(.45), linewidth = .6) + geom_point(position = position_dodge(.45), size = 1.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, title = ttl, subtitle = sprintf("per position, fitted per fold (small dots), speaker RE, AR(1) rho = %.2f; 95%% t-interval across folds", attr(nd, "rho"))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7.5, height = 4.8, dpi = 200); p
}

# 3. surface: increment as a function of base uncertainty x distance to the clause end, for P and V
Ls <- L[cue %in% c(lab("P"), lab("V")) & is.finite(dist_to_clause_end)]; Ls[, cue := droplevels(cue)]
m2 <- bam(dI ~ cue + te(base_entropy, dist_to_clause_end, by = cue, k = c(8, 6)) + s(fold, bs = "re") + s(speaker, bs = "re"),
          data = Ls, method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = NTHR)
nd <- CJ(base_entropy = seq(0, quantile(L$base_entropy, .99, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 40), dist_to_clause_end = 0:8,
         cue = levels(Ls$cue)); nd[, `:=`(speaker = L$speaker[1], fold = L$fold[1])]
nd[, fit := predict(m2, nd, exclude = c("s(speaker)", "s(fold)"), discrete = FALSE)]
nd[, cue := relabel(cue)]
p2 <- ggplot(nd, aes(dist_to_clause_end, base_entropy, fill = fit)) + geom_raster() + facet_wrap(~cue) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "nats") + labs(x = "words until the next clause end", y = "words-so-far model entropy", title = ttl) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave(file.path(FIGDIR, "surface.png"), p2, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 200)

5. Differences between cues (paired per decision), with the regions where they are significant¶

In [102]:
# 5. differences between cues, paired per decision (the same word under the same fold model), fitted per fold like the
# increments; the band is the 95% t-interval across folds and the thick segments mark where it excludes zero.
PAIRS <- list(c(lab("P"), lab("V")), c(lab("P"), lab("D")), c(lab("V"), lab("D")), c(lab("P+V+D"), lab("P")))
mk_diff <- function(Ltab, pairs) {
  pairs <- Filter(function(pr) all(pr %in% levels(Ltab$cue)), pairs)
  ids <- c("sid", "speaker", "fold", "tok_idx", "pos01", "from_end", "from_start", "base_entropy", "dist_to_clause_end", "open_now", "start")
  W <- dcast(Ltab[, c(ids, "cue", "dI"), with = FALSE], as.formula(paste(paste(ids, collapse = " + "), "~ cue")), value.var = "dI")
  out <- list()
  for (pr in pairs) {
    nm <- sprintf("%s - %s", pr[1], pr[2])
    out[[nm]] <- W[, c(ids), with = FALSE][, `:=`(cue = nm, dI = W[[pr[1]]] - W[[pr[2]]])]
  }
  D <- rbindlist(out); D[, cue := factor(cue, levels = names(out))]
  D[is.finite(dI)]
}
LD <- mk_diff(L, PAIRS)
with_L <- function(newL, expr) { old <- L; assign("L", newL, envir = globalenv()); on.exit(assign("L", old, envir = globalenv())); eval(expr) }

plot_diff_smooth <- function(cv, axis, xlab, file) {
  cv <- copy(cv); cv[, cue := relabel(cue)]; cv[, sig := lo > 0 | hi < 0]
  p <- ggplot(cv, aes(x = .data[[axis]], y = fit, colour = cue, fill = cue)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = .15, colour = NA) + geom_line(linewidth = .5, alpha = .6) +
    geom_line(data = cv[sig == TRUE], aes(group = interaction(cue, rleid(sig))), linewidth = 1.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) + facet_wrap(~cue, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "difference in increment (nats / decision)", title = ttl,
         subtitle = "paired differences, fitted per fold; 95% t-band across folds; thick where it excludes zero") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 200); p
}
plot_diff_means <- function(nd, xlab, file) {
  nd <- copy(nd); nd[, cue := relabel(cue)]; nd[, sig := lo > 0 | hi < 0]
  p <- ggplot(nd, aes(x, fit, colour = cue)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = .25) + geom_line(linewidth = .5, alpha = .6) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2.2) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 16, `FALSE` = 1), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) + facet_wrap(~cue, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "difference in increment (nats / decision)", title = ttl,
         subtitle = "paired differences per position, fitted per fold; 95% t-interval across folds; filled: excludes zero") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 200); p
}
cv <- with_L(LD, quote(fit_smooth("base_entropy"))); fwrite(cv, file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_base_entropy.csv"))
print(plot_diff_smooth(cv, "base_entropy", "words-so-far model entropy at the decision (nats)", file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_base_entropy.png")))
cv <- with_L(LD, quote(fit_smooth("pos01"))); fwrite(cv, file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_pos01.csv"))
print(plot_diff_smooth(cv, "pos01", "position in the sentence (0 = first word, 1 = last word)", file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_pos01.png")))
nd <- with_L(LD, quote(fit_means("from_end"))); fwrite(nd, file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_from_end.csv"))
print(plot_diff_means(nd, "words before the end of the sentence (0 = last word; 10 = 10 or more)", file.path(FIGDIR, "diff_from_end.png")))

6. Beyond prosody: what V and A add on top of P (and on top of W+P)¶

In [103]:
# 6. what the body (V) and acoustic distinctiveness (D) add BEYOND prosody, with two bases:
#    (a) beyond words and prosody:  W+P+V - W+P,  W+P+D - W+P,  W+P+V+D - W+P   (the paper's framing)
#    (b) cue-only, no words:        P+V - P,      P+D - P,      P+V+D - P
# Conditions that have not run yet are skipped with a message.  The base-entropy axis is still the words-so-far
# model's entropy, so the curves are comparable with sections 1-5.
groups <- list(
  words   = list(c("W+P", "W+P+V", "W+P+V - W+P"), c("W+P", "W+P+D", "W+P+D - W+P"), c("W+P", "W+P+V+D", "W+P+V+D - W+P")),
  cueonly = list(c("P_full", "P+V", "P+V - P"), c("P_full", "P+D", "P+D - P"), c("P_full", "P+V+D", "P+V+D - P")))
for (g in names(groups)) {
  L6 <- build_L(groups[[g]]); if (nrow(L6) == 0) next
  tag <- paste0("beyondP_", g)
  for (ax in c("pos01", "base_entropy")) {
    xl <- if (ax == "pos01") "position in the sentence (0 = first word, 1 = last word)" else "words-so-far model entropy at the decision (nats)"
    cv <- with_L(L6, quote(fit_smooth(ax))); fwrite(cv, file.path(FIGDIR, sprintf("%s_%s.csv", tag, ax)))
    print(plot_smooth(cv, ax, xl, file.path(FIGDIR, sprintf("%s_%s.png", tag, ax))))
  }
  lv <- levels(L6$cue)
  if (length(lv) >= 2) {
    pairs6 <- combn(lv, 2, simplify = FALSE); pairs6 <- lapply(pairs6, function(pr) if (nchar(pr[1]) >= nchar(pr[2])) pr else rev(pr))
    LD6 <- mk_diff(L6, pairs6)
    for (ax in c("pos01", "base_entropy")) {
      xl <- if (ax == "pos01") "position in the sentence (0 = first word, 1 = last word)" else "words-so-far model entropy at the decision (nats)"
      cv <- with_L(LD6, quote(fit_smooth(ax))); fwrite(cv, file.path(FIGDIR, sprintf("%s_diff_%s.csv", tag, ax)))
      print(plot_diff_smooth(cv, ax, xl, file.path(FIGDIR, sprintf("%s_diff_%s.png", tag, ax))))
    }
  }
}
